action.sql: SELECT (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(g.debit - g.credit), 0) FROM gl_lines g WHERE g.entity_id = 'US01' AND g.period = '2026-03' AND g.account_id = '6400' AND g.dept_id = 'MKT') AS actual, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(b.amount), 0) FROM budgets b WHERE b.entity_id = 'US01' AND b.period = '2026-03' AND b.account_id = '6400' AND b.dept_id = 'MKT') AS budget, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(g.debit - g.credit), 0) FROM gl_lines g WHERE g.entity_id = 'US01' AND g.period = '2026-03' AND g.account_id = '6400' AND g.dept_id = 'MKT') - (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(b.amount), 0) FROM budgets b WHERE b.entity_id = 'US01' AND b.period = '2026-03' AND b.account_id = '6400' AND b.dept_id = 'MKT') AS variance
